# Bundled leadership skills

`opinionated-skills/` is an MIT-licensed export from Volpestyle/skills.
`opinionated-skills.json` pins its base revision, selected paths and local
changes. Clankie's native hire/message guidance under ADR 0213 now lives in
the pinned upstream source, including ADR 0218/VUH-1615 unadopted worker parent
routing; the snapshot carries no local changes.
The legacy lead-skill npm archives are retained as historical provenance,
not the shipped catalog; [provenance.json](provenance.json) records their hashes.

Release assembly dereferences the selected product links. Personal skill
links continue to resolve to their original repositories and remain untouched.
See [the bundle guide](../docs/bundled-skills.md) for inventory and refresh steps.
